text.p: The following English and Scottish
league soccer matches scheduled for Wednesday have all been
postponed due to snow and frost:
English premier league - Derby v Sheffield Wednesday,
Leicester v Tottenham, Southampton v Wimbledon.
Division one - Barnsley v Oldham, Birmingham v Manchester
City, Crystal Palace v Reading, Oxford v Grimsby, Port Vale v
Southend, Sheffield United v Wolverhampton, Swindon v Queens
Park Rangers.
Division two - Brentford v Wycombe, Bristol Rovers v
Plymouth, Crewe v Millwall, Luton v Bury, Notts County v
Bournemouth, Peterborough v Watford, Preston v Wrexham,
Rotherham v Gillingham, Stockport v York, Walsall v Bristol
City.
Division three - Colchester v Leyton Orient, Darlington v
Carlisle, Lincoln v Wigan, Mansfield v Fulham, Rochdale v
Hereford, Scarborough v Cambridge, Scunthorpe v Chester, Swansea
v Doncaster.
Scottish Premier division - Motherwell v Kilmarnock.
Division one - Falkirk v Airdrieonians, Greenock Morton v St
Mirren.
Division two - Ayr v Stranraer, Clyde v Brechin, Dumbarton v
Stenhousemuir, Hamilton v Queen of South
Division three - Alloa v East Stirling, Queen's Park v
Albion, Ross County v Inverness C Thistle.
